# Doctor Quick Reference
## External bleeding
1. Select the body zone in targeting. 2. Empty hand: apply direct pressure. 3. Gauze: dress the selected external wound. 4. Brutepack: pack the selected deep external wound. 5. Tourniquet: occlude bleeding from the selected arm or leg. 6. Repeat the scan and restore lost circulating volume.
## Unconsciousness or absent circulation
1. Check oxygenation, circulating blood, perfusion, and rhythm. 2. Stop external bleeding sources. 3. Apply oxygen or use an NCManualVentilator. 4. Perform CPR with an empty hand when perfusion is absent. 5. Use a Defibrillator for Shockable Arrest. 6. Administer compatible blood or crystalloid. 7. Repeat the scan.
## Fracture
1. Select the injured region. 2. Apply an NCFieldSplint for temporary stabilization. 3. Confirm the fracture with the full body scanner. 4. Open the Freeform Surgical Field. 5. Incise and retract over the fracture, reduce displacement, apply fixation, and suture the site. 6. Repeat the full scan.
## Internal trauma
1. Place the patient in a MedicalScanner. 2. Open the computerBodyScanner console. 3. Check Regions, Wounds, Organs, Cyberware, and Drugs. 4. Select the affected body zone. 5. Use the operation sequence listed in the Surgery section. 6. Repeat the full scan.
